r02.
There is no per-user API rate-limiting middleware and no request-limit configuration. Echo registers `Recover` and CORS (`server/server.go`); API auth is the gateway/Connect interceptor (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go`, `authz.go`). Rate limiting appears only as an unimplemented email-docs suggestion (`internal/email/README.md`).
